recommendation: Keep the audit commit as a marker for Pharmacy review. A follow-up source-changing commit should only be made after the WG decides the detailed Timing v2/TQ/TQ1 mappings, whether Dosage.timing's existing 'TQ1-X / ORC Quantity/timing' value belongs in the published v2 mapping column, and whether the reporter's post-application Dosage mapping concerns should change the current RXE/RXO/TQ entries.
issue_request: FHIR-17354 asked whether HL7 v2 mappings could be added for the Dosage and Timing FHIR data types; it was Published/Persuasive with resolution to add v2 mappings for dosage and timing.
initial_application: Jira records application by merge commit 7a787c5ab6b278c2af6d3644c38931486b7330f4 on 2018-10-30. The first-parent diff for that merge added v2 mapping entries to source/datatypes/dosage.xml but did not change source/datatypes/timing.xml.
additional_context: Current build-scope configuration still renders Dosage and Timing datatype mappings. Current Dosage source retains many v2 mappings, but Dosage.timing has an empty v2 Mapping cell while an adjacent unknown mapping column contains 'TQ1-X / ORC Quantity/timing'. Current Timing source has a v2 Mapping column but only maps root Timing to 'N/A'; detailed Timing rows have no v2 mapping entries. The reporter's later Jira comment and Zulip discussions show unresolved uncertainty about TQ/TQ1/RX* timing semantics and field choices, with no discovered final Pharmacy decision resolving the details.
reconciliation: Published an empty human-review audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were changed because adding, moving, or correcting Timing/TQ/TQ1/RX* mapping entries would require a work-group or mapping-specialist decision rather than a mechanical reconciliation.
